title: Does the recipe's best keep fraction fall as context grows? Keep 70%..1.25% at 2k-64k, single-length pools, dense held-out-loss proxy
result: No. Best keep is 20-40% at every length the proxy resolves and does not fall with length: 8k 40% (tied with 20%), 16k 20-40% tie, 32k 40% beats the recipe at matched FLOPs on both seeds (-0.019 / -0.010 CE; 70% ties: -0.022 / -0.002), 64k 20% (40% +0.015 / +0.017 on both seeds). Low keeps break harder the longer the rows: 10% vs the recipe at matched FLOPs +0.003 CE at 8k, +0.002/+0.014 at 16k, +0.011/+0.031 at 32k, +0.080/+0.033 at 64k; 2.5% collapses at 32k/64k and 1.25% at 64k (+0.60). Constant fraction fits; a constant kept-token count (would predict 20/10/5% at 16/32/64k) is rejected. 2k/4k saturate (held-out CE ~0.01): unresolvable. Below 20% the per-step FLOP saving flattens (64k: 0.185 -> 0.140x dense) because blocks 0-6 stay dense. Margins between 20% and 40% are no larger than the seed spread (up to 0.027 CE at 64k). At 64k, 70% is +0.047 at matched FLOPs but the only router arm whose every task reaches dense's mid-epoch level (1 seed). Proxy: eval_size 144 per length (below 500), ranks only, cannot resolve < ~0.03-0.05 CE.

title: Gold-aware stochastic keep (grJ) at 8k, 32k, 64k and its outlier-safe variant (grJc, document drop on contradiction only) at 32k and 64k
result: grJ (all rows; 0.10 / 0.08 / 0.067 of dense FLOPs per step at 8k / 32k / 64k) stalls on outlier at every length: final outlier CE 0.182 / 0.177 vs dense full FT 0.068 at 8k (2 seeds), 0.249 vs 0.187 at 32k, 0.284 vs 0.220 at 64k; outlier never reaches dense's mid-epoch CE. At 8k this decides the mean: mean CE never reaches dense's mid-epoch level (0.092 vs level 0.081; dense ends 0.045), both seeds; at 32k / 64k the mean still shows 6.2x / 8.4x vs dense at that level. qdmatch_nq reaches it at 5.8-21x at every length, contradiction at 4.5-5.8x at 8k/32k, not at 64k. Gold share of documents is 0.5-7% for all tasks, so grJ drops documents on all three tasks (8k: 1,535 / 1,527 of 1,802 rows dropped, doc-token keep 0.42). grJc (32k 2 seeds, 64k 1): 32k 4.16x / 4.15x mean, worst task 2.82x on seed 0 but contradiction not reached on seed 1; 64k 4.10x mean with contradiction and outlier not reached: outlier-safe at 32k, not at 64k. Proxy, eval_size 144 per length (below 500).
